summary: Audit candidate variant additions to a parent listing: decide merge vs separate vs duplicate vs reject, citing the exact local signal-row and policy-clause evidence that drove each call.

checks.description: variant_audit.json exists and parses, and every proposed child SKU appears exactly once with a valid decision enum (accept|reject|needs_fix); no missing, extra, duplicate, or invalid decisions.
TRAIL-750-BLK decision is accept (same product, color variation).
TRAIL-750-BLU decision is accept (same product, color variation).
TRAIL-750-RED decision is accept (same product, color variation).
TRAIL-750-2PK decision is reject or needs_fix (pack-count theme not enabled for parent).
TRAIL-750-GLASS decision is reject (material mismatch with parent canonical 304 stainless steel).
TRAIL-INFUSER-GRN decision is reject (functional accessory difference).
TRAIL-750-KIDS decision is reject (capacity/use case difference).
TRAIL-750-BAMBOO decision is reject (cap material/cap-style not an approved dimension on this parent).
TRAIL-1000-SIL decision is reject or needs_fix (capacity differs from parent canonical 750ml).
TRAIL-750-BLK-FBA decision is reject or needs_fix (duplicate fulfilment workflow record of an archived black child).

Every candidate decision is grounded in BOTH a matching signal/source/catalog file row (with a row-specific token in the same evidence item's cite) AND a matching policy clause (with a clause-specific phrase). The verifier checks each SKU's signal and policy evidence individually; failing (sku, signal|policy) pairs are listed in the reason.
revised_variation_matrix.csv contains exactly the accepted+needs_fix children (no rejected, no missing, no extras) and includes the core accepted SKUs.
